title: EffectSlice: Eligibility-Gated Certificates for Task-Local Procedural Effects
title_zh: EffectSlice：任务局部过程效应的资格门控证书
hypothesis: For an independently locked user task, an eligibility-gated, source-grounded, sealed admission protocol can identify a strict nonempty subset of a complete paper-derived skill whose cost-adjusted paired effect, contracts, and guardrails are equivalent to the eligible complete artifact, while reducing procedure count and local cost and abstaining when the claim is unsupported.
core_innovation: A reducer-agnostic admission decision that binds a positive-full-effect eligibility gate, deterministic paper-source procedure units, and one sealed task-local effect-preservation certificate family. The novelty claim excludes subset search, pruning, SCC condensation, provenance, equivalence testing, dependency closure, and one-deletion minimality individually.

method.summary: Freeze one paper-task manifest; verify that the complete artifact F has a positive cost-adjusted effect over a same-scaffold no-skill baseline B; compile deterministic source-grounded atoms; preserve the feasible subset family through exact SCC condensation; allow any frozen reducer to propose strict nonempty slices; use fresh paired runs and a complete alpha ledger for discovery; lock one slice and audit every retained-unit deletion neighbor; then apply the identical sealed confirmation gate to EffectSlice, a permuted-margin control, and direct ClawTrace, Graph-of-Skills, and SkillRAE outputs.
step_ids: S3 Gate on positive full effect
S6 Condense and verify the exact quotient
S7 Register candidates and reserve audit budget
S8 Propose slices without seeing fresh outcomes
S9 Measure and filter discovery slices
S10 Lock the slice and audit every deletion neighbor
S11 Run sealed confirmation and matched admissions
S12 Freeze development and report held-out decisions
method.scope: One paper, one independently locked task, and at most 16 post-condensation SCC units per certificate. No global-minimum, cross-task, or cross-paper certificate is claimed.

experiment_plan.development: Use the existing eight real-reuse paper-task rows to implement and freeze the parser, atomization, dependency quotient, eligibility rule, margins, error families, Q ledger, search worker, baseline adapters, scorers, and budgets. Development outcomes cannot be used as held-out evidence.
experiment_plan.held_out: Acquire at least four genuinely new paper-task pairs with untouched source maps, complete artifacts, executable assets, and locked scorers. Freeze the eligible sampling frame and exclusion rules before running any held-out pair.
experiment_plan.primary_endpoint: Correctly admitted nonempty compact-artifact rate among all held-out pairs, retaining incorrect admissions and every gate abstention in the denominator.
secondary_endpoints: False-admission rate under the frozen external reference procedure
Paired effect gap relative to F and whether its simultaneous interval stays inside [-epsilon, epsilon]
Original procedure-count reduction and measured local cost reduction
experiment_plan.negative_control: Permute discovery M_tau labels among same-size contract-passing candidates before selection. On untouched confirmation runs, the selected control should leave the equivalence band and move toward B more often than the unpermuted worker.
experiment_plan.success_condition: Relative to the three direct baselines under matched task and branch budgets, EffectSlice must improve correctly admitted compact-artifact rate without increasing false admission, while accepted slices remain nonempty, smaller than F, equivalent in cost-adjusted effect, and free of corrected contract or guardrail failures.
experiment_plan.falsification_condition: The mechanism fails if the matched admission advantage is absent, accepted slices do not preserve F on untouched runs, or the M_tau permutation does not degrade the downstream effect gap.
experiment_plan.budget: Upper bound: 12 tasks, 2,028 branch runs, and $3,500 trusted vendor API usage including a 15% rerun reserve. An ordinary local PC performs orchestration, tool execution, scoring, and verification; DeepSeek V3.2 is the primary inference service. No local GPU is required. Return budget_infeasible or insufficient_query_budget rather than changing seeds or hypotheses after observing outcomes.

baseline_expectation: ClawTrace, Graph-of-Skills, and SkillRAE may produce compact artifacts, but the hypothesis is that applying one beneficial-F, atom/source-validity, contract, guardrail, and sealed confirmation gate to every output will reduce false admission and increase correctly admitted compact artifacts. This expectation is not an existing result.

novelty_status.reason: Retrieved direct neighbors have partial rather than exact overlap, but candidate-specific terms were not externally transmitted and older behavior-preserving program reduction/statistical delta debugging families remain unresolved.

open_author_decisions: S1: publish the primary scorer, contract and guardrail predicates, missing-value behavior, paired resampling unit, confidence-bound procedure, and membership/correction rule for each error family.
S10: preregister a total ordering and tie-break for choosing T_star from multiple survivors.
S11: define a baseline-neutral normalization policy for outputs that lack exact source spans, executable regions, or contract roles, including reject/abstain/exclude behavior.
S12: define the held-out paper-task population, sampling and exclusion rules, and outcome-independent reference procedure for labeling false admission.
risk_factors_and_limitations: Novelty remains unverified against behavior-preserving program reduction, statistical delta debugging with equivalence tests, prompt pruning, and minimal-sufficient-rationale families.
The certificate is task-local and limited to at most 16 SCC units; it does not identify a globally smallest or cross-task core innovation.
High abstention is expected when the complete artifact is not beneficial, atomization is ambiguous, the dependency graph is invalid, or the query budget cannot cover every final neighbor.
Deterministic four-way atomization may be brittle across heterogeneous skill formats and source maps.
Baseline normalization can bias the comparison unless the method-neutral conversion and applicability rule are frozen before outcomes.
At least four genuinely new pairs with reliable assets and scorers do not yet exist in the current evidence package.
The multiple-testing family is large, so power may be inadequate even within the stated compute budget.
The existing PaperToSkill real-reuse evidence is single-run and mixed; it cannot be counted as evidence that EffectSlice works.
No ordinary-user study is included. Claims that the method helps ordinary people require a separate usability/time-to-correct-use evaluation and cannot be inferred from artifact or task scores.
